description: This JavaScript file defines the Icelandic culture information for the DateJS library, including date formats, names of days and months, and related parsing/formatting functions.

methods.name: clearTime
methods.description: Resets the time component of a date to midnight.

methods.name: setTimeToNow
methods.description: Sets the time component of a date to the current local time.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a copy of the date object.
